references.text: Moses describes the promised land as including the mountains, the lowlands, the Negev, and the coastal plain—the same geographical areas that Joshua conquered.
Goshen is mentioned as part of the land explored by the spies, the same area that Joshua conquered.
A parallel description of Joshua's conquest of the hill country, the Negev, the lowlands, and the foothills—summarizing the same geographical regions.
Lists the same geographical areas—the mountains, the lowlands, the Arabah, and the foothills—that Joshua conquered from the kings.
Moses is shown the entire land from Mount Pisgah, including the Negev region that was later conquered by Joshua.
Goshen is mentioned as a city in the lowlands of Judah, part of the area that Joshua conquered.
The promise that the Lord's eyes are always upon the land from the beginning of the year to its end—the land that Joshua has now conquered.
